scope: One isolated updated episode-six opening board at CampaignStage 11, with Alphen plus five joined allies at authored EntryLevel. Prior completion flags/levels exist only in new in-memory fixtures. No natural progression, story completion, rewards, AI/balance or full-campaign claim.
captures: 14 unedited ScreenCapture frames: the episode-six board idle at 0/90/180/270 degrees, legal Director movement in flight/at arrival, and a damage-pose-only fixture at 1280x720; one Alphen character focus frame; command and skill-list HUD at 1280x720, 1024x768 and 2340x1080; landscape Editor sizes are not Android-device evidence. Damage does not execute the resolver or change HP. No effect/skill-execution claim.
checks: Active model count, authored non-null sprites, finite ground/path placement, contact-shadow presence, supported materials, tile-pick round trips, rotation state/RNG invariance, actual legal movement completion, damage-fixture state invariance, visible UI glyph/button boundaries and exact requested resolution. Sprite AABB camera containment is telemetry only because transparent artwork padding is not visible geometry.
limitations: Automated pass is not visual approval. Inspect PNGs for palette harmony, terrain occlusion, visible foot anchoring, contact-shadow quality, character/background separation and UI readability. One episode-six opening board is not all maps/poses/resolutions or performance coverage. User-storage hashing covers every top-level file, including backups and temporary files, except the exact case-insensitive Unity live-log names Player.log and Player-prev.log. An external wrapper may additionally hash nested files and directory paths with the same root-log exclusions. No user files are restored.
